profile.assetsSubtitle: Uploaded straight away — no need to save.

profile.stampHint: Printed on tax invoices. PNG or JPG, up to 5MB.

rooms.capacitySubtitle: How many rooms and floors the property has.

facilities.newFacilityPlaceholder: Type a facility and press Enter
facilities.amenitiesSubtitle: Extras billed on top of the room rate.

food.title: Food & meal plans

tax.gstSubtitle: Tax charged on bookings and bills.

documents.kycSubtitle: Documents collected from guests at check-in, and the largest file allowed.
documents.expiryHint: System will send alerts when guest KYC documents are about to expire within this window.

pricing.rulesSubtitle: Raise or lower rates automatically on occupancy, length of stay or lead time.

pricing.chartSubtitle: Average competitor daily rate for each room type.

notifications.title: Automated message schedule
notifications.subtitle: Messages sent to guests automatically. Switching one on or off applies straight away.

properties.editingHint: Editing — use Save changes at the top when done.

appearance.themeSubtitle: Switches straight away on this device.

appearance.accentSubtitle: Previewed live as you pick; Save changes keeps it for this property.

branding.identitySubtitle: PNG or SVG with a transparent background works best. You can crop after selecting.
branding.tileHint: Click the tile to upload. Shown on the sign-in screen and across the app — use Save changes after changing it.

preferences.regionalSubtitle: Language, currency and how dates and times are shown.

preferences.soundAlertsHint: Play a chime for new bookings and check-ins
preferences.emailDigestHint: Receive a summary of the day's activity each evening
preferences.autoLogoutHint: Lock the dashboard after 30 minutes of inactivity

invoice.numberingSubtitle: The serial printed on every tax invoice.
invoice.serialHelp: <mono>{{fixed}}</mono> is fixed; the <mono>-DD/MM</mono> is taken automatically from the booking's date, and the last <mono>NN</mono> counts bookings for that day (restarts at 01 daily). The number is assigned when an invoice is first generated and can still be edited per invoice.
invoice.bankSubtitle: The Bank Details block only appears on the invoice when a bank name is set.
invoice.accountNamePlaceholder: Defaults to hotel name if blank
invoice.termsPlaceholder: e.g. Check-out by 11 AM. Taxes as applicable.
